fewShots.question: what do we have about cancelled appointments?
fewShots.query:
-- Enter a SQL query that could answer the question using your data

WITH q AS (SELECT AI_GENERATE_EMBEDDINGS('cancelled appointments' USE MODEL aivia_embeddings) AS v)
 SELECT TOP 10 c.node_id, c.name, c.business_name, c.description,
   VECTOR_DISTANCE('cosine', c.emb, q.v) AS distance
 FROM semantic_catalog c CROSS JOIN q
 ORDER BY distance;
